source.title: ProspectMate, a Dragonflight-compatible prospecting and milling tracker (no public run dataset)
source.author: urutseg

notes: NEW original-export avenue, not a measured cohort. ProspectMate documents tracking per-player conversion outcomes and reset on changes to skill, Inspiration or Resourcefulness; its public description supplies NO Dragonflight numeric outputs, completed casts, per-material hits, refund counts or histograms. Other processing libraries found document eligibility/recipes, not cast logs. Prior Reddit/Jallfo/Bugy/Xenastro/Aary studies and Wowhead Looter gear cohorts are already represented. Do not count addon reference tables, nominal ore or old copies as new measurements. Next useful source must include original author raw casts and context.
lookingFor: Independent Dragonflight per-operation raw exports for Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite and Prismatic prospecting, plus Bubble Poppy and Saxifrage milling: completed casts, per-output hits, zero outcomes and 0-N histograms by input rank, skill and refunds
whereLooked: GitHub code search: Draconium Ore prospecting completed-cast result logs, per-output histograms; no raw Dragonflight cohort found
CurseForge ProspectMate addon: documented Dragonflight tracking/export/reset behavior; no public raw character samples or outcomes
CurseForge LibProcessable: recipe/processability detection, not prospect/mill result distribution
Reddit r/woweconomy named Bubble Poppy and Saxifrage mill logs and histograms; known Aary reports already present, no new raw casts
Warcraft Wiki named Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting output tables; recipes/outputs only, no independently measured ranks-by-cast sample
Method named Saxifrage milling yield guides; no per-cast raw 0-N observations
